records.verification_method: Official NeurIPS proceedings paper PDF; title and abstract screened.
records.abstract_evidence_excerpt: Large Language Models (LLMs) are widely used in today’s tasks of natural language processing. To support applications like multi-turn chats, document understanding, and content generation, models with long context lengths are growing in importance. However, managing long contexts brings substantial challenges due to the expansion of key-value cache (KV cache). Longer KV cache requires larger memory, limiting the batch-size and thus decreasing throughput. Also, computing attention over long KV cache incurs more memory access, hurting the end-to-end latency.
